title: The Cannizzaro Reaction
subject: Chemistry
objective: Two identical aldehyde molecules, two different products. How an aldehyde with no α-hydrogen, in concentrated alkali, is oxidised and reduced in the same reaction.

tf.q: Benzoic acid is obtained only after acidifying the salt.

ar.a: The Cannizzaro reaction is a disproportionation.
ar.r: One molecule is oxidised and another identical molecule is reduced.
